title: Arms Sales Notification
items_summary: Correction to the graphic for Transmittal No. 22-63, which was mistakenly replaced with a graphic referencing Transmittal No. 22-69 in an earlier notice (2024-18294, pages 66360-66362, August 15, 2024).
summary: This Federal Register notice corrects an earlier arms sales notice (document 2024-18294, published August 15, 2024) in which an incorrect graphic referencing Transmittal No. 22-69 was printed in place of the correct graphic for Transmittal No. 22-63. The notice itself contains only the corrected graphic; the text does not state the purchasing country, dollar values, equipment, or contractors.
